title: Hosted API: Endpoint residency modes, adaptive retention profiles & evidence automation playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Background: Customers operating in regulated jurisdictions require two capabilities from our Hosted API: (1) precise control over where tenant data is routed and stored, and (2) deterministic retention and proof artifacts that satisfy auditors. Current pinning primitives are functional but lack an admin-facing policy surface, flexible retention tiers, and a reliable evidence export workflow for legal/compliance teams.

Goal: Deliver an integrated feature set that lets tenants declare endpoint residency modes (strict/hybrid/advisory), attach adaptive retention profiles per endpoint, and produce automated, signed evidence packages delivered via webhook/S3 or console download. Reduce support and engineering handoffs when customers request proof of residency/retention.

Key user stories: 
- As a platform admin, I can set an endpoint to Strict mode so requests for that tenant only route to pinned regions and failover to alternate regions is disabled.
- As a compliance lead, I can attach a retention profile (e.g., 7d/90d/forever) to a tenant or per-endpoint and have the system apply TTLs and redaction rules automatically.
- As a security auditor, I can request a time-bound evidence bundle that includes route traces, retention config snapshots, and signed attestations for a specified window.
- As an operator, I can view policy conflicts in a concise simulator before applying changes to production.

Constraints & non-goals: 
- We will not ship on-prem controller changes in this ticket; scope is hosted control plane and evidence packaging only. 
- Deep data residency certification for third-party clouds (e.g., custom legal attestations) is out of scope for initial rollout.

Compliance/regulatory notes: Must capture immutable audit trail (who/when/what), cryptographically sign evidence bundles, and retain proofs according to customer-requested retention windows. Integration with customer KMS for signing is a follow-up (see dependencies).
acceptance_criteria: Endpoints can be set to one of three residency modes: Strict, Hybrid, Advisory from the Console and API.
Retention profiles can be created and attached to tenants/endpoints; profiles enforce TTL and map to retention enforcement engine.
Evidence bundle API exists: POST /v1/tenants/{id}/evidence-requests returns a signed bundle URL within SLA (<= 5 minutes for typical 30-day window).
Console UI shows a pre-apply simulator that highlights routing changes and potential conflict with existing pins.
Audit events are recorded for any change (who/what/previous-state/new-state) and visible in Console and exportable in the evidence bundle.
Automated webhook delivery of evidence bundles to customer-specified endpoints with retry/backoff and HMAC verification.
End-to-end test coverage for policy enforcement modes and retention expiry flows (unit + integration + e2e smoke).
technical_notes: Residency modes: Strict = only pinned regions; Hybrid = prefer pinned but allow fallback to approved secondary regions; Advisory = soft preference with telemetry only.
Routing: Extend smart routing policy to respect residency mode flags; add policy precedence table to resolve multiple pin sources (tenant, endpoint, org policy).

Retention enforcement: Leverage existing retention service; add profile metadata and enforcement labels to persisted records so purge jobs can filter by profile. Handle redaction vs deletion semantics per profile.

Evidence bundle format: ZIP with manifest.json, signed by platform key. Manifest contains list of objects: route_trace.ndjson, retention_snapshot.json, change_log.ndjson, and checksums. Support optional customer S3 upload target and webhook URL delivery.

Performance: Evidence generation should stream artifacts and avoid hot scans; use incremental query windows and precomputed indexes for routing traces. Target mean generation time < 3 minutes for 30-day window under standard tenant size.
Security: Sign bundles with platform signing key; include verification metadata. For customers needing stronger attestations, follow-on ticket will support customer-managed keys (KMS).
Simulator: Build a lightweight dry-run evaluator that fetches current pins and evaluates policy precedence; do not mutate production state during simulation. Provide UI diff view for admins.
comments: 2026-02-20 - PM sync: agreed to three modes (Strict/Hybrid/Advisory). Engineering raised concerns about fallback latency during region failover; added perf requirement to tech notes.
2026-02-28 - Design feedback: prefer simple switch in the endpoint settings with an advanced policy editor for multi-tenant admins. Provided initial mock link in 'links'.
2026-03-05 - Eng review (Miguel): proposed streaming evidence generator to avoid OOM on large windows. Added ENG-67200 as follow-up for streaming infra work.
2026-03-10 - Legal review: confirmed manifest contents are sufficient for standard audits; requested explicit retention labeling in snapshots. Added to acceptance criteria.
